name: rav_entitlement_status
description: Report this machine's activation id and state. Without token: returns machine_id, the value to send when requesting an activation key. With token: verifies the key, stores it for this machine and user account, and keeps it active until it expires; the advertised tool set may change and a tools/list_changed notification is sent.

token.description: Activation key issued for this machine. Omit to check the state or read machine_id.

name: rav_inspect_full
description: Return the full inspection of the currently open file. Requires scope inspection.full: listed in tools/list only while this machine is unlocked for that scope. Works without a token argument once unlocked.

token.description: Optional activation key. Not required while already active.

name: rav_analyze_full
description: Generate an analysis report of the currently open file (HTML, Markdown and/or PDF) into output_dir. Listed only while this machine is active for the required scope; no token needed once active.

token.description: Optional activation key. Not required while already active.

formats.description: Report formats to generate. Defaults to ["html"] when omitted.

output_dir.description: Absolute path of the directory to write the report(s) into; it is created if it does not exist.
